battle.name: 馬赫迪戰爭
battle.theater: 蘇丹喀土穆與尼羅河東岸
battle.brief: 一八八一年馬赫迪在蘇丹宣布起事，英埃聯軍在十八年裡三次進攻喀土穆。一八八五年救援遠征隊把六管加特林機槍帶到埃爾泰布與塔邁，用連發火力掩護第二十團的刺刀衝鋒，最終仍沒能救出被圍的戈登。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 交戰的兩大陣營，一方是蘇丹的馬赫迪國家，一方是英埃聯軍。馬赫迪一方於一八八一年六月十八日由穆罕默德·艾哈邁德在傑貝爾歐拜德宣布自立為馬赫迪，設都於烏邁邁，一八八三年一月遷入喀土穆，其後由哈里法阿卜杜拉希以恩圖曼為中心執政。其武裝以「安薩爾」為主體，旗下分為數十個旅團，每旅由部落徵召的步兵、射手、標槍手與少數騎兵組成，通常以黑旗為號誌，另有以紅旗為號的「先知之旗」隊伍，以及隨軍作後勤與警戒的非作戰人員。英埃一方先是埃及王國的基德維爾軍：土耳其蘇丹的屬國埃及以英籍陸軍顧問整訓的埃及步兵與砲兵為骨干，徵募敘利亞與安納托利亞士兵充當散兵「巴希巴佐克」，並以尼羅河上的汽艇與砲艇作為行動與補給的骨幹。一八八二年英軍佔領埃及之後，英國直接介入：一八八五年組成的「救援喀土穆駐軍」遠征軍由沃爾斯利率領，一八八六年起設立「蘇丹總督」一職，由基奇納掌軍，英埃共管的體制由此成形。義大利在一八九〇年代進入蘇丹東部，在卡薩拉一線與馬赫迪軍交戰，並於一八九六年支援衣索比亞抵抗義軍，使這場原本局限於內陸的起事，變成一八九〇年代牽動東北非國際棋盤的長期戰事。
countriesEn: The two great camps in this war were the Mahdist state in the Sudan on one side and the Anglo-Egyptian forces on the other. The Mahdist side grew out of the proclamation of 18 June 1881, when Muhammad Ahmad al-Mahdi declared himself Mahdi at Jebel Obeid, made his capital at al-Mahdiyya, moved into Khartoum in January 1883, and after 1885 ruled from Omdurman under the Khalifa Abdallahi. Its armed body was built around the Ansar and divided into a number of divisions, each raised from the tribal levies with infantry, marksmen, spear-men and a few horsemen, marching under the black flag, together with the Red Flag troops of the Prophet's banner and the non-combatant households attached to the army for logistic and guard duty. The other side began as the Khedival army of Egypt: the vassal state of the sultan of Turkey, whose Egyptian infantry and artillery were trained by British advisers, whose ranks were filled with Syrian and Anatolian recruits serving as bashibazouks in the skirmish line, and whose Nile steamers and gunboats formed the backbone of movement and supply. After the British occupation of Egypt in 1882, Britain entered directly: the Save the garrison of Khartoum expedition of 1885 was led by Wolseley, and from 1886 the office of Sirdar of the Sudan was created and held by Kitchener, which produced the Anglo-Egyptian condominium. Italy entered the eastern Sudan in the 1890s, fighting the Mahdists in the Kassala district and backing Abyssinia against the Italian army in 1896, so that what began as an inland rising in 1881 became by the 1890s a long war drawn into the international board of north-east Africa.
people: 馬赫迪穆罕默德·艾哈邁德是這場戰爭的起點與象徵。他以蘇丹中部部族的支持者為基盤，聚集軍眾於傑貝爾歐拜德，宣布自己是先知所許的馬赫迪，廢除埃及的稅關與行政，改以「安薩爾」的名義徵召民眾。圍繞他的哈里發體制在日後成型：阿卜杜拉希·本·穆罕默德掌管東蘇丹並以恩圖曼為根據地，阿里·迪納爾掌西蘇丹與達夫爾，穆罕默德·沙里夫控制白尼羅河上游，阿里·瓦德希盧守北喀土穆。埃及方面，優素福·帕夏以基德維爾總督的身分被困在喀土穆，於一八八三年一月在埃爾歐拜德慘敗後把城池交給馬赫迪軍；瓦倫丁·貝克（英方稱其為赫克斯帕夏）率領的遠征縱隊在同役全滅，英方情報從此認定蘇丹不能再用埃及式的方式治理。查爾斯·戈登是最關鍵的外來人物：他一八六四年起在赤道區推行廢奴，又在一八八三年冬至一八八四年初完成救援赤道站的行軍，繼而成為喀土穆總督，圍城期間以電報與馬赫迪談判，拒絕撤退，最終在一八八五年三月二十六日陣亡，成為英國殖民敘事中的殉道者。加尼特·沃爾斯利接掌救援遠征，於一八八五年初率縱隊溯尼羅河而上，在埃爾泰布與塔邁兩役擊破馬赫迪軍，卻仍遲了數日。真正的收尾由赫伯特·基奇納完成：他一八八六年出任蘇丹總督，以鐵路、汽艇與封鎖線推進，一八八五年在第一次阿特巴拉之役中已以參謀身分參戰，一八九八年九月二日在恩圖曼擊潰馬赫迪主力，哈里法阿卜杜拉希於一八九九年十二月陣亡於烏姆迪卡特，殘部投降。此外，被圍的辛卡特守軍指揮官伊夫林·伍德，以及一八八四年十二月馳援辛卡特的格拉漢准將，也各在這條補給線上留下關鍵一筆。
peopleEn: Muhammad Ahmad al-Mahdi is the beginning and the symbol of the war. He built a following among the tribes of the central Sudan, gathered his men at Jebel Obeid, announced that he was the Mahdi promised by the Prophet, abolished the Egyptian taxes and offices, and called up the people under the name of the Ansar. The khalifa system grew up around him afterwards: Abdallahi ibn Muhammad held the eastern Sudan with Omdurman as his base, Ali Dinar held the west and Darfur, Muhammad Sharif controlled the upper White Nile, and Ali wad Hilu held the northern approaches. On the Egyptian side, Yusuf Pasha, the Khedival governor, was shut up in Khartoum and after the rout at El Obeid in January 1883 handed the city to the Mahdists; the Egyptian column commanded by Valentine Baker, known to the British as Hicks Pasha, was destroyed in the same battle, and British intelligence concluded from it that the Sudan could no longer be governed in the Egyptian manner. Charles Gordon was the decisive outsider. He enforced the suppression of the slave trade in Equatoria from 1864, carried out the march to the relief of the Equatorial stations between the winter of 1883 and the beginning of 1884, and became Governor-General of the Sudan, where he was shut up in Khartoum and conducted his negotiations with the Mahdi by telegraph, refusing to withdraw, and was killed on 26 March 1885, becoming the martyr of the British colonial narrative. Garnet Wolseley took over the relief expedition, marched up the Nile with his column in the beginning of 1885 and broke the Mahdist army at El Teb and Tamai, but arrived a few days too late. The closing of the war was the work of Herbert Kitchener: he became Sirdar of the Sudan in 1886, advanced by railway, steamer and blockade line, had already taken part in the first battle of Atbara in 1885 as a staff officer, and destroyed the main Mahdist army at Omdurman on 2 September 1898, after which the Khalifa Abdallahi was killed at Umm Diqqat in December 1899 and the remnants surrendered. Two more names belong to the same thread of supply: Evelyn Wood, who commanded the besieged garrison at Sinkat, and Gerald Graham, who led the relief of Sinkat in December 1884.
kits: 加特林機槍在這場戰爭裡不是主角，卻在幾個關鍵時刻壓住了攻勢。它是一八六〇年的六管手搖式轉管機槍：六根槍管圍成一圈，由炮手用曲柄連續轉動，發射時六根管子依次射擊，把後坐力攤薄到六次，射速因此遠高於任何單發槍，設計者的說法是能壓住一個師。實際操作並不輕鬆：機身連同支架重達百餘公斤，需要四到六人搖動與餵彈，槍身水套要隨時補水，在沙漠行軍中水源與零件補給都成問題。它的戰術位置在英埃軍的「連發機槍」一欄，由步兵支隊攜帶，也常架在尼羅河汽艇與砲艇的船首，沿河掃射兩岸的馬赫迪游擊隊。一八八五年救援遠征隊溯尼羅河而上，加特林機槍隨縱隊行進，在埃爾泰布與塔邁兩役中為第二十團第二營的刺刀衝鋒和第十三孟加拉輕騎兵的橫向衝擊提供掩護，成為這支縱隊唯一能在短時間內打出彈幕的武器；同一時期英軍步兵主力是馬丁尼-亨利步槍，砲兵是七磅與九磅野砲，埃及軍另有散兵與騎兵協同。馬赫迪軍這邊的裝備以繳獲為主：埃爾歐拜德一役之後，馬赫迪軍從瓦倫丁·貝克的遠征縱隊手中繳獲大量步槍、彈藥與野砲，另有蘇丹本地舊式火繩槍、阿富汗傑扎伊爾槍與標槍；最特別的是把紙殼彈殼綁在矛尖的「彈殼矛」，射擊完畢便以矛突進，把火器與冷兵器接成同一個動作。運輸方面，英方靠尼羅河汽艇、槍炮艇與一八八六年鋪設的沃迪哈勒法至阿布哈米德沙漠鐵路，馬赫迪軍則用駱駝隊與奪來的船隻。
kitsEn: The Gatling gun is not the protagonist of this war, but at several decisive moments it held the attack in place. It is the six-barrel hand-cranked rotary gun of 1860: six barrels set in a circle are turned continuously by a crank, firing in turn so that the recoil is divided into six, and the rate of fire is therefore far above that of any single-shot weapon, the designer's claim being that it could hold a division. Operation was not light: the machine and its mount weigh something over a hundred kilograms, four to six men are needed to crank and feed it, the water jacket has to be replenished, and in the desert both water and spare parts were a problem. Its tactical place in the Anglo-Egyptian order of battle was in the repeating rifle column, carried by infantry detachments, and it was often mounted in the bows of Nile steamers and gunboats to sweep the banks against Mahdist irregulars. In 1885 the relief column went up the Nile with Gatling guns in its baggage, and at El Teb and at Tamai they gave covering fire to the bayonet charge of the 2nd Battalion, 20th Foot and to the flanking charge of the 13th Bengal Lancers, being the only weapon in the column able to lay down a barrage in a short space of time. The same column's infantry relied on the Martini-Henry rifle and its artillery on seven- and nine-pounder field guns, with Egyptian skirmishers and cavalry in support. The equipment of the Mahdist army was mostly captured: after El Obeid the Mahdists took large quantities of rifles, ammunition and field guns from the column of Valentine Baker, and also had the old matchlocks of the Sudan, the Afghan jezail and the assagai; the strangest item was the cartridge spear, with a paper cartridge lashed to the point so that a man could fire and then close with the shaft in one movement. On the British side movement rested on the Nile steamers, the gunboats and the desert railway laid from Wadi Halfa to Abu Hamed in 1886; the Mahdists used camel trains and boats they had taken.
tactics: 馬赫迪軍的戰術，是把自己的弱點轉成一套方法。步兵以數十人至數百人的密集縱隊前進，進至英軍火線射程內即以土壘、村莊廢墟、荊棘與高粱地為依托，蹲伏成線，等英軍砲火停止後一次齊射，再以矛兵和綁著彈殼的矛手接續衝鋒；密集本身就是一種消耗手段，用人數去換英軍的彈藥與陣形的崩解。他們極少做正面強攻，而偏好夜襲、側擊與切斷補給線，長期糾纏英軍的汽艇隊與商隊；攻城時挖壕、逼近至步槍射程、逐段填壕，圍困喀土穆、辛卡特與薩瓦金線上的英軍據點都沿用這一套。英埃軍這邊則是近代化砲兵與步兵的配合：砲艇沿尼羅河以加特林機槍與輕砲封鎖岸線，縱隊登岸後以野砲做準備射擊，步兵在連續射擊掩護下以密集陣線前進，抵近後放下步槍改用刺刀；加特林機槍的任務正是壓住對面散兵線、讓密集縱隊無法靠近，讓刺刀衝鋒得以進行。一八八五年英軍還用過「三路縱隊」的方案，沃爾斯利將遠征兵力分為三支平行縱隊沿不同路線北上互相策應，但同時又抽出大量兵力護衛河上船隊，導致推進遲緩，救援最終失敗。一八八六年之後戰法轉為以鐵路與汽艇為軸的機械化推進：以沙漠鐵路把兵員、物資與九磅砲直接送到前線，英軍再以封鎖線把馬赫迪軍分割，最後由基奇納在阿特巴拉與恩圖曼兩役中用連續砲火和正面衝鋒，把對方從陣地裡逐出。
tacticsEn: The Mahdist tactics were a method of turning their own weakness into a system. Their infantry advanced in dense columns of tens to hundreds, came into British range, and then settled behind earthworks, ruined villages, thorn and sorghum as cover, crouched in line, and after the British artillery fire stopped let off one volley, after which the spear-men and the men with cartridge-tipped lances went forward in the charge. Density itself was a form of attrition, trading numbers against British ammunition and against the breaking of the British formation. They rarely attacked straight ahead, preferring night raids, flanking movement and the cutting of supply lines, harrying the river steamers and the caravans for long stretches; when they did besiege a place they dug trenches, pushed up to rifle range and filled them in section by section, and the siege of Khartoum, the blockade of Sinkat and the pressure on the Suakin line were all carried out in that manner. The Anglo-Egyptian side was the modern combination of artillery and infantry: gunboats on the Nile sealed the banks with Gatling guns and light pieces, the column landed and opened with field-gun preparation, the infantry advanced in dense line under continuous fire, and at close range dropped the rifle for the bayonet. The task of the Gatling gun was precisely to pin the enemy's skirmish line, to hold the dense columns off and to make the bayonet charge possible. In 1885 the British also used the three-column scheme, Wolseley dividing the expedition into three parallel columns on different routes to support one another, but while also drawing off a great many men to guard the river craft, which slowed the advance and made the relief fail. After 1886 the method changed to a mechanical advance pivoting on the railway and the steamers: the desert railway carried troops, supplies and nine-pounder guns straight to the front, the British closed the country with blockade lines to cut the Mahdists into separate pieces, and Kitchener at Atbara and Omdurman used continuous artillery fire and frontal attack to drive the Mahdists out of their positions.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。時間跨度：一八八一年至一八九九年，前後十八年；起點是穆罕默德·艾哈邁德於一八八一年六月十八日在傑貝爾歐拜德宣布自立，喀土穆圍城起於一八八一年九月，該城在一八八三年一月二十六日淪陷。埃爾歐拜德之役在一八八三年一月十二日，瓦倫丁·貝克的埃及遠征縱隊約三千人全滅，馬赫迪軍繳獲其全部野砲與大批槍械彈藥。戈登救援赤道站之行軍自一八八三年十一月至一八八四年二月；沃爾斯利的喀土穆救援遠征則自一八八四年十二月自沃迪哈勒法出發，縱隊核心約一千一百人，另有汽艇隊與砲兵同行。埃爾泰布戰役在一八八五年二月二十四日，塔邁戰役在一八八五年三月十三日，英軍在兩役的陣亡合計約一百五十人上下，多出於第二十團第二營與第十三孟加拉輕騎兵。加特林機槍的一八六〇年六管型由四至六人操作，手搖時每分鐘可射百餘發。第一次阿特巴拉之役在一八八五年四月八日；一八八六年沙漠鐵路開工；第二次阿特巴拉之役在一八九八年四月八日，恩圖曼之役在一八九八年九月二日，英埃軍陣亡約一千餘人，馬赫迪軍陣亡以萬計。一八九九年十二月哈里法阿卜杜拉希陣亡於烏姆迪卡特，殘部投降，戰事告終。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. In time the war ran from 1881 to 1899, eighteen years in all; it began with Muhammad Ahmad al-Mahdi's proclamation of 18 June 1881 at Jebel Obeid, the siege of Khartoum opened in September 1881, and the city fell on 26 January 1883. The battle of El Obeid was fought on 12 January 1883, and the Egyptian column of Valentine Baker, about three thousand men, was destroyed to the last, the Mahdists taking all its field guns and a great quantity of arms and ammunition. Gordon's relief of the Equatorial stations ran from November 1883 to February 1884; Wolseley's relief of Khartoum set out from Wadi Halfa in December 1884 with a column of about eleven hundred men, with a steamer force and artillery in company. The battle of El Teb was fought on 24 February 1885 and that of Tamai on 13 March 1885; British dead in the two battles together came to something like a hundred and fifty, most of them in the 2nd Battalion, 20th Foot and the 13th Bengal Lancers. The 1860 six-barrel Gatling was worked by four to six men and could fire a hundred rounds a minute by hand. The first battle of Atbara was fought on 8 April 1885; the desert railway was begun in 1886; the second battle of Atbara was fought on 8 April 1898 and that of Omdurman on 2 September 1898, the Anglo-Egyptian force losing about a thousand men killed and the Mahdist dead being counted in tens of thousands. In December 1899 the Khalifa Abdallahi was killed at Umm Diqqat, the remaining garrisons surrendered, and the fighting came to an end.
cause: 戰爭的起因，是一連串壓力在一八八一年同時爆開。埃及自一八二一年之後統治蘇丹，徵稅、徵役與奴隸貿易把許多部落推入抵抗；英籍軍官查爾斯·戈登自一八六四年起在赤道區推行廢奴，觸動巴加拉人、阿拉伯人與達夫爾一帶的利益，他離任之後反抗也並未平息。七十年代後期實行「閉關政策」，外國商旅與探險者不得進入，蘇丹被鎖在外部世界之外，軍政機關對地方酋長的約束力也隨之瓦解。一八八〇年之後埃及在蘇丹的駐軍擴張；一八八一年二月白尼羅河上游爆發起義，三月一支埃及遠征軍在索巴特河與白尼羅河匯合處被「安薩爾」擊潰，指揮官陣亡。於是開戰前的兩個關鍵條件同時具備：一是部落社會願意公開拿起武器，二是埃及軍在內陸已無可靠的前進基地。馬赫迪本人提供了把這兩者結合成一場戰爭的力量：他以宗教天命的名義宣布自己是最後的馬赫迪，廢除埃及的稅制與機關，改以安薩爾的編制徵召民眾，並以「真主之旗」統率各部落。原本各自獨立的反抗於是被收攏為一場跨越白尼羅河、達夫爾、赤道區與喀土穆的長期戰爭。
causeEn: The war began because a number of pressures came to a head at the same moment in 1881. Egypt had ruled the Sudan since 1821, and its taxation, conscription and slave trade had driven tribe after tribe into resistance; the British officer Charles Gordon, who enforced the suppression of the slave trade in Equatoria from 1864, struck at the interests of the Bagara, the Arabs and the people of Darfur, and the revolt did not die down after he left. The closed-door policy of the later 1870s shut the Sudan off from foreign merchants and explorers and left the government with little hold on the local chiefs, and after 1880 the Egyptian garrison in the Sudan was enlarged. In February 1881 a rising broke out in the upper White Nile, and in March an Egyptian expeditionary force was destroyed by the Ansar at the junction of the Sobat and the White Nile with its commander killed, so that two of the necessary conditions were in place before the fighting began: the tribal communities were willing to take up arms openly, and the Egyptian army had no reliable base left from which to advance inland. What the Mahdi supplied was the power to bind these things into a single war. In the name of religious mandate he announced himself to be the last Mahdi, abolished the Egyptian taxation and administration, called up the people under the Ansar, and led the separate tribes with the flag of God. What had been a set of unconnected revolts thus became a single long war stretching across the White Nile, Darfur, Equatoria and Khartoum.
impact: 這場戰爭改寫了蘇丹的政治版圖，也把英國拖進了東北非。馬赫迪國家在一八八三到一八八五年間消滅了埃及在蘇丹的整個行政體系，喀土穆、易卜魯欣與喀土穆河上游的據點相繼易手，蘇丹第一次出現一個由本土宗教領袖主持、以部落民兵為軍隊的中央政權；它的組織方式——安薩爾、哈里發、旅團制——在後來的蘇丹與索丹里亞一帶仍留有痕跡。對英國而言，一八八三年介入、一八八五年救援失敗、一八八六年設蘇丹總督，標誌著埃及不再是英國可以放手不管的屬地，一八九九年英埃共管條約更把蘇丹的行政權與財政權正式切分。技術面同樣是一次換代：加特林機槍在一八八五年還能用來壓制縱隊，到一八九〇年代已被馬克西姆機槍取代，英軍在恩圖曼一役靠的是連發機槍搭配更遠程的火砲，火力結構從單一機槍過渡到重砲與機槍的組合，這條換代線正是英軍最終能壓過大規模步兵的技術原因。文化上，戈登之死為英國殖民敘事提供了一名殉道者，喀土穆在英國文獻中的形象至今偏向悲劇；馬赫迪的陵寢在一八九八年恩圖曼之後被毀，其後又被重建，今天仍是恩圖曼的地標。
impactEn: The war redrew the political map of the Sudan and dragged Britain into north-east Africa. Between 1883 and 1885 the Mahdist state destroyed the whole Egyptian administrative apparatus in the Sudan: Khartoum, Berber and the posts upriver changed hands one after another, and for the first time the Sudan had a central authority led by an indigenous religious leader and fought by tribal levies; its organisation, the Ansar, the khalifas and the divisional system, left traces in the Sudan and in Somaliland long afterwards. For Britain, intervention in 1883, the failure of the relief in 1885 and the creation of the Sirdar of the Sudan in 1886 marked the end of the assumption that Egypt could be left to look after itself, and the Anglo-Egyptian Convention of 1899 formally separated administrative and fiscal rights in the Sudan. Technologically this was a transition as well: a weapon like the Gatling gun could still pin a column in 1885, but by the 1890s it had been replaced by the Maxim, and the British at Omdurman relied on repeating rifles together with longer-range artillery, the shift from a single machine gun to a combination of heavy guns and machine guns being the technical reason the British could finally overwhelm massed infantry. In cultural terms Gordon's death gave British colonial writing a martyr, and the image of Khartoum in British literature has stayed tragic to this day; the Mahdi's tomb was destroyed after Omdurman in 1898 and later rebuilt, and it remains a landmark of Omdurman today.
result: 結果是馬赫迪國家在存續十八年後覆滅，蘇丹重回埃及與英國的秩序之下。過程分三段：一八八一到一八八五年，埃及與英國在蘇丹全面失利，埃爾歐拜德全滅埃及遠征縱隊，戈登救援赤道站得手，而沃爾斯利在埃爾泰布與塔邁雖兩度擊退馬赫迪軍，卻因遲了數日而救不回喀土穆，戈登在一八八五年三月陣亡，該城隨後落入馬赫迪軍之手。一八八六年基奇納出任蘇丹總督，用沙漠鐵路、汽艇封鎖線與分進合擊，花了十年收復白尼羅河、達夫爾與蘇丹—埃及邊界；他早在一八八五年四月八日的第一次阿特巴拉之役就已出手，一八九八年四月八日在第二次阿特巴拉擊破阿里·迪納爾與阿卜杜拉希的聯軍，同年九月二日在恩圖曼以正面縱列射擊與騎兵衝鋒摧毀馬赫迪主力，英軍隨後攻入喀土穆與恩圖曼，一八九九年哈里法阿卜杜拉希在烏姆迪卡特陣亡，各處據點相繼投降，馬赫迪國家的抵抗至此完全結束。留下的結果是：蘇丹的行政權回到埃及與英國共同支配之下，一八九九年的英埃共管成為此後數十年的基本架構；而加特林機槍這一類連發武器在這十八年裡從主角退為配角，最終被馬克西姆機槍取代，蘇丹的戰爭史也從此轉入以火砲與裝甲車為核心的新階段。
resultEn: The result was that the Mahdist state, after eighteen years, was destroyed and the Sudan returned to the order imposed by Egypt and Britain. The process ran in three stages. From 1881 to 1885 Egypt and Britain were beaten everywhere in the Sudan: at El Obeid the Egyptian column was destroyed, Gordon relieved the Equatorial stations, and Wolseley twice threw the Mahdists back at El Teb and Tamai, but arrived a few days too late to save Khartoum; Gordon was killed in March 1885 and the city then fell to the Mahdists. In 1886 Kitchener became Sirdar of the Sudan and spent a decade recovering the White Nile, Darfur and the Berber-Suakin line with the desert railway, the steamers and the blockade lines; he had already taken part in the first battle of Atbara on 8 April 1885, and on 8 April 1898 he broke the combined army of Ali Dinar and Abdallahi at the second battle of Atbara, and on 2 September of the same year destroyed the main Mahdist army at Omdurman with frontal volleys and the cavalry charge, after which the British entered Khartoum and Omdurman; in 1899 the Khalifa Abdallahi was killed at Umm Diqqat, the remaining garrisons surrendered one after another, and the resistance of the Mahdist state came wholly to an end. What was left was this: administrative authority in the Sudan returned to the joint dominion of Egypt and Britain, and the Anglo-Egyptian condominium of 1899 became the basic framework of the following decades; and weapons of the Gatling class, the repeating guns, went in these eighteen years from the leading place to a supporting one and were finally displaced by the Maxim, so that the war history of the Sudan turned to a new stage in which artillery and armoured vehicles stood at the centre.
